source.statement: A closed connected Lie-rational subgroup with a rational filtration admits a Malcev basis relative to its actual intersection with the ambient lattice.

publication.title: Green and Tao, The quantitative behaviour of polynomial orbits on nilmanifolds
publication.locator: Definitions2.1,2.3,2.5 pp478–480 and Proposition A.10 p534
publication.corrections: Read with final2014 erratum: one-variable results retained, multiparameter application restricted to corrected equal-side theorem. Local right-period and affine repairs are kept distinct.

rows.needed: Every K_i=exp(sum_{a in J,|a|>=i} g_a) has a lattice K_i intersect Gamma in the actual bounded-tautified model.
rows.derivation: The displayed finite sum is a rational ideal, as the local bracket argument proves. Use the rational Lie-subalgebra lattice theorem with a fixed finite rational filtration, exactly as in the degree-rank case at69–73. This new application uses sums of original multidegree ideals rather than claiming they are identical to the earlier bracket spans.
rows.boundary: The prior bounded tautification supplies H and its lattice. No quantitative uniformity over varying geometric models and no use of compactness as its own premise.
